goal: Repair scoped recur trace-id symbol extraction, binary filtering, keyword token boundaries, and role duplication while preserving legacy JSON schemas and existing test contracts.
invariants: Scoped role-query JSON schemas remain strictly backwards compatible: single-ID queries return an object with request, identifier, define, produce, consume, trigger and NO top-level 'schema' key (preserving julia-tests/main.improvement.34.trace.test.jl line 57); glob queries return a JSON array of those objects; site records keep path, line_number, line, and edge_type.
Piping recur trace-id ... --json into recur merge --stdin (julia-tests/runtests.trace-id.jl lines 567-597) remains 100% compatible.

C#-style constant symbol extraction (e.g. public const string OwnershipCreate = "ulu.topic.dot.ownership.create"; -> OwnershipCreate in julia-tests/runtests.trace-id.jl lines 110-156) and Eventness/lane assignment definitions (id = value, define id = value) remain intact.

Keyword arguments such as Python consumes=["robo.mod.traction"] or produces=("...") must never extract role keywords ('consumes', 'produces', 'defines', 'trigger') or configured role keywords as transitive C#/code symbol names.
collect_scoped_lines honors traversal.skip_binary_files and traversal.max_file_bytes so binary artifacts such as __pycache__/*.pyc are never scanned as lossy UTF-8 text.

Word-like role keywords (such as 'register', 'publish', 'send', 'emit', 'bind', 'subscribe') match on identifier token boundaries (preserving registry.Register(...) and register(...), while rejecting compound snake_case identifiers like board_register or interface_register); punctuation keywords such as '*.' and 'register(' retain substring matching.

Diagnostics when detail-only flags (--depth, --format, --stdin, saved-run flags) are passed without --scope retain '--scope' in stderr (preserving julia-tests/main.improvement.34.trace.test.jl line 52) while replacing confusing 'legacy --scope query' phrasing with clear guidance.
recur trace-id remains strictly read-only unless explicit --save-run is requested.
A failing baseline demonstrates the scoped role-classification defects; it does not prove a fix or satisfy final acceptance.

observations: recur trace-id 'robo.mod.traction' --scope '**' -d C:/src/kicad_ra --json returned 1,505 bogus consume hits (including unrelated README lines containing the English word 'consumes') because extract_symbol_name_from_definition extracted 'consumes' from Python keyword argument consumes=["robo.mod.traction"] and searched every occurrence of 'consumes' across the repository.
collect_scoped_lines read scripts/__pycache__/*.cpython-312.pyc via fs::read + String::from_utf8_lossy without applying skip_binary_files, injecting binary garbage into JSON line fields.
Substring matching on default trigger keyword 'register' misclassified JSON field '"board_register": "docs/robo..."' as a trigger site.

Every pure consume/produce/trigger site was simultaneously duplicated into define because classify_line defaulted to roles.define = true whenever line_has_identifier was true, and --format full printed identical (path, line_number) lines multiple times without role labels.

Running recur trace-id 'robo.mod.traction' --depth 1 without --scope failed with 'Invalid arguments: --depth, --format, --stdin, and saved-run flags require a legacy --scope query', leading agents to think --scope was deprecated even though --list-ids and --context also require --scope.

final_state.description: Scoped recur trace-id role queries classify define, produce, consume, and trigger accurately across Python, Rust, C#, Markdown, and JSON repositories without keyword-argument symbol explosion, binary .pyc leakage, snake_case substring false positives, or role duplication, while keeping every existing JSON schema and Julia/Rust regression test green.
required_observations: Python/Rust/JS keyword arguments like consumes=["robo.mod.traction"] do not extract 'consumes' as a symbol name and do not trigger repository-wide word explosions.
Binary files (NUL-containing files such as .pyc) and files exceeding traversal.max_file_bytes are skipped during collect_scoped_lines when skip_binary_files / max_file_bytes are active.
Identifier-bounded role keyword matching rejects 'board_register' for keyword 'register' while still matching 'registry.Register(...)', 'register(...)', and 'trigger advance'.

Lines classified as consume, produce, or trigger without an explicit definition marker (=, define/defines, JSON "defines"/"trace_id") are not duplicated into define, while bare/assignment/const definitions and C# symbol references continue to pass all assertions in runtests.trace-id.jl, runtests.lane.coordination.jl, and runtests.demo.skippy.jl.

--format full avoids printing duplicate unlabeled lines for the same (path, line_number) site (annotating or grouping roles cleanly), and missing --scope errors clearly explain --scope <SCOPE> without calling --scope 'legacy'.
